title: The Watch That Stopped
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：value　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 value 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother left me her watch. It had stopped in 1997 and nobody thought it was worth anything; the shop on the corner ① valued it at twenty yuan, and the man behind the counter seemed almost sorry to say so. Money is one kind of value, my mother said afterwards, and not the useful one.

My mother runs a small shop and sells nothing dear. She has never earned much and has never pretended to. What she ② values above everything else is time: she closes at six o'clock every evening, whatever the market suggests, and she ③ values any customer who comes back twice far more than a single large order.

Growing up behind that counter I learned prices before I learned much else, and I also learned how easily prices lie. A cheap coat that lasts two winters is not cheap at all. My mother calls this good ④ value, and she is careful to add that it is not the same thing as being inexpensive.

A property company once offered her three times the price of the shop, meaning to knock it down and build something taller. 'Its market ⑤ value would double,' the man said. She did not answer at once. Her own mother had made her promise that the counter would never be moved, and she had always placed a high ⑥ value on keeping one's word. 'It has more value to me as it is,' she said finally, and folded her arms.

Last year I studied economics for the first time and met the ⑦ value in a formula: the number a letter stands for, which never changes. It made me laugh. Nobody has ever handed me an equation for deciding which of my own ⑧ values I would give up first, or what one honest hour is worth. The watch still does not work, and I do not wear it often; my mother's advice has been of more ⑨ value to me than anything printed in a textbook, and I suspect its true ⑩ value is not for me to decide.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 价值（可用金钱衡量的价格）
B. n. 重要性；有用性（精神层面的价值）
C. n. 价值观；准则（常用复数 values）
D. n. （数学、测量中的）数值
F. v. 给……估价（value sth at ...）
G. 固定搭配：(be) good value / of great value 物有所值／很有价值
H. 固定搭配：place a high value on 高度重视

items.q: values above everything else is time
values any customer who comes back twice
placed a high value on keeping one's word
which of my own values I would give up first
has been of more value to me
its true value is not for me to decide

answers.why: value sth at＋金额，是动词“估价”，店员把这块停了的表估作二十元。
value＋宾语 time＋above everything else，是动词“珍视、重视”，母亲最看重时间。
同样是动词“重视”，value sb/sth far more than ...，此处指更看重回头客。
good value 是固定搭配，意为“物有所值”，与下句“不等于便宜”形成对比。
market value 指“市场价值”，是可用金钱衡量的价格。
place a high value on＋抽象名词，意为“高度重视”，这里指重视守诺。
公式中的 value 指字母所代表的“数值”，后一句 which never changes 即指此义。
my own values 是名词复数“价值观”，指一个人所信守的准则。
of more value to sb 意为“对某人更有价值”，与第 4 题同属一组固定搭配。
its true value 指物品在情感层面的“真正价值”，无法折算成钱。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 街角那家店把这块表估价为二十元。（value v.）
我母亲把时间看得比什么都重。（value v.）
这件外套物有所值，因为它能穿两个冬天。（good value）
如果拆掉重建，那里的市场价值会翻一番。（market value）
外婆一向高度重视信守诺言。（place a high value on）
母亲的忠告对我而言比任何课本都更有价值。（of more value）
answers: The shop on the corner valued the watch at twenty yuan.
My mother values time above everything else.
This coat is good value, because it lasts two winters.
If it were knocked down and rebuilt, its market value would double.
My grandmother always placed a high value on keeping one's word.
My mother's advice has been of more value to me than any textbook.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 value 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: The shop on the corner valued my grandmother's watch at twenty yuan, and nobody thought it was worth anything.
My mother values time above everything else, closing the shop at six whatever the market suggests.
She calls cheap shoes that last only one winter poor value, whatever the price says.
She always placed a high value on keeping one's word, since her own mother had made her promise it.
In economics I met the value in a formula, but no equation tells you which of your own values to give up first.
In the end the watch's true value is beyond price, which is why I have never sold it.
